title: Divisorial fine saturated log regular pairs
statement: Let $V$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $Z\subseteq V$ a closed subset [def-pc-scheme] with dense open complement $j:U\hookrightarrow V$. On the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $M=\mathcal O_V\cap j_*\mathcal O_U^\times$: on an etale $W\to V$, this consists of regular functions on $W$ whose restriction to $W\times_V U$ is invertible, with multiplication and its inclusion into $\mathcal O_V$. This is the divisorial log structure of $(V,Z)$. A chart is an etale-local homomorphism $P\to M$ from a commutative monoid for which, at each geometric point with strict local ring $A$, the induced map $P\oplus_{\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)}A^\times\to M_{\bar v}$ is an isomorphism; the displayed pushout identifies the elements of $P$ mapping to units with those units. Here the strict local ring is the colimit of rings of sections on pointed etale neighbourhoods. A commutative monoid $P$ is fine saturated if it is finitely generated, embeds in its group completion $P^{\rm gp}$, and $g\in P^{\rm gp}$ and $ng\in P$ for some integer $n>0$ imply $g\in P$. The log structure is fine saturated if it has such charts. The pair $(V,Z)$ is log regular if this log structure is fine saturated, its triviality locus (where $M_{\bar v}=A^\times$) is exactly $U$, and at every geometric point $\bar v$ the following holds. Put $\overline M_{\bar v}=M_{\bar v}/A^\times$ and let $I\subseteq A$ be generated by the images of the nonunits of $M_{\bar v}$. Then $A/I$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] and $\dim A=\dim(A/I)+\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbf Z}(\overline M_{\bar v}^{\rm gp})$, where dimension is Krull dimension and rank means dimension after tensoring the abelian group with $\mathbf Q$.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.1--1.4, printed pp. 69--70: etale fine saturated log structures, the stratum/dimension definition, and the divisorial log structure of a pair.
